visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing a white short-sleeved shirt and a bright red tie stands in a bright, spacious piano showroom. He gestures toward the camera with his hands while various grand pianos and paintings in ornate gold frames are visible in the background background. (2) A woman enters the frame from the right side, wearing a black lace dress and a voluminous white faux-fur shrug. She exhibits high-energy facial expressions, wide smiles, and animated hand gestures as she stands next to the boy near a large black grand piano. (3) The camera focuses on the intricate internal gold-colored frame and strings of a massive black grand piano. The lighting is bright and studio-like, highlighting the reflective surfaces of the piano's open lid and the polished floor of the venue. (4) A modern, sleek black and silver grand piano is presented, followed by a sequence showing a vibrant, neon-pink custom-colored piano. The woman is seen interacting with these instruments, placing her hands on the keys and gesturing toward the unique designs and colors. (5) The woman sits at a grand piano and plays, with the camera providing close-up shots of her hands moving across the black and white keys. Additional close-up shots focus on her feet wearing black high heels as she operates the three gold pedals of the piano. (6) A large wooden crate labeled with brand markings is shown outdoors, being unloaded from a truck. The scene shifts back to the indoor showroom where the woman continues to speak directly to the camera with various text overlays appearing on screen.
